newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said it could be assumed that 1,600 tonnes of UK beef had been exported through Belgium to the Netherlands, and to Russia and Egypt.
Van der Pas denied press reports that British beef had been illegally marketed in France and Spain and could not confirm reports of exports to other third countries.

In answer to a question van der Pas said some of the beef was marked as it would be to be legally commercialised in the UK and that it could therefore be assumed that the meat was not contaminated by the mad cow disease.

Van der Pas confirmed the Spanish authorities were worried and said the Commission had sent them further details on Thursday morning. He said he was not aware of measures taken in view of a Spanish ban on Belgian beef.

He said the UK exports controls had been "manifestly ineffective" and that the Commission was considering opening an infringement procedure against Britain. He denied that the Commission was considering similar procedures against other member states in this matter.
He did not deny that Belgium could be an administrative hub for illegal beef exports.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/599: Commission approves joint venture between Munich Re and three French insurance companies.
- IP/97/601: Cohesion Fund: ECU 53 million for Portugal.
- IP/97/603: Cohesion Fund: ECU 1.5 million for drinking-water supply network in Veria. Greece.
- IP/97/604: Cohesion Fund: ECU 72 million for environment projects in Ireland.
- IP/97/605: The Commission adopts 1996 Cohesion Fund annual report.
- IP/97/606: The Commission authorises the creation of a joint venture by Rhone-Poulenc and Merck.
- IP/97/607: Gibraltar Social Insurance Fund: Commission closes infringement proceedings against United Kingdom.
- IP/97/608: Commission takes Greece to Court for discrimination against women employees.
- Speech/97/152: Commissioner Franz Fischler closing speech at Scientific Conference on Meat-and-bone meal.
- Memo/97/67: Euro-Mediterranean Partnership: implementation of the multilateral aspects of the Barcelona declaration.
